engineering_notes.6: sim/priest/shadow_word_death.go: Forever's tier 5 Early Demise talent gives it bonus crit chance below 20% target health, read through the engine's execute-phase approximation (isExecutePhase E20). The cast itself is on cooldown, not held for the execute phase.

notes: Rotation-accuracy program, wand-weaving addition (2026-09-28): Shoot (5019) is declared inert because this build's item table (data/builds/<active>/items/priest.json filtered to simitems.json's known ids) has no wand with required_level <= 10, so the ladder's level-10 rung equips nothing in the ranged slot and core.RegisterShootSpell never registers the spell there; from level 20 on, once a wand is available, it resolves and fires heavily (the level 20-60 rungs below show it as up to 82 percent of top casts on this bare, no-consumes, no-buffs ladder character). Adapted from the fork's shadow_priest/apls/p1.apl.json. Devouring Plague's off-by-one registration bug (an old 'Fix round 1' that had temporarily moved this file's authored id back to rank 5) and the follow-up 'rank 5 casts instead of rank 6' diagnosis are both stale and superseded (audit-priest, 2026-09-28): sim/priest/devouring_plague.go's registration loop runs the full 1..DevouringPlagueRanks range, this file's strictSequence has authored rank 6 (19280) since before this audit, and a direct 3000-iteration reproduction of the level-60 bare-gear ladder request (forever-sim, engine b5ac36a52) casts 19280 and never 19279. Shadow Word: Death (1309636, sim/priest/shadow_word_death.go) is implemented and does deal damage under isExecutePhase(E20) -- the same reproduction cast it 408 times over 3000 iterations (avg 0.136/iteration) -- it is simply rare on the ladder's bare, no-mana-regen gear: it is priced at 340 mana, sits behind Shadow Word: Pain's upkeep in priority, and only has a window when BOTH the execute phase is open AND mana remains, so a specific 300-iteration seed landing on zero casts (this ladder's golden) is not surprising and is not the engine-primitive bug the previous note attributed it to (see expected_idle below; that comparison to paladin-retribution's Hammer of Wrath and warrior-fury's Execute conflated a real resource-scarcity effect with the shared isExecutePhase primitive, which this reproduction shows working correctly for Shadow Word: Death). Engine numbers (audit-priest, 2026-09-28): Shadow Word: Pain's and Devouring Plague's BonusCoefficient were hardcoded to vanilla-Classic-shaped values (an escalating table topping out at 0.167, and 0.063) that this build's own spellconst carries no support for; spellconst's sp_coefficient is a flat 0.2 for every Shadow Word: Pain rank and a flat 0.1 for every Devouring Plague rank, fixed on fork branch audit-priest (unpushed; needs a real engine-pin bump once merged). Shadowform is still cast at prepull, Shadow Word: Pain is maintained with the same fight-end guard as the source preset, and Inner Focus into Devouring Plague, Mind Blast on cooldown, and Mind Flay as filler are otherwise unchanged. Every rank named here is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/. Theorycraft audit fix (design/reviews/2026-10-31-theorycraft-audit/casters.md P1, P2, P3): Mind Blast moved above Mind Flay, Devouring Plague is kept up on its 24-second cooldown instead of only behind Inner Focus, Inner Focus now feeds Mind Blast, and the duplicate execute Mind Blast line went away. The engine now applies Shadowform's half cost and crit bonus to Mind Blast. About +12 percent in that run. Round-2 audit (design/reviews/2026-11-01-sim-audit-round2/casters.md): Shadow Word: Death is cast on cooldown rather than only below 20% health, the order Warcraft Tavern and wowtbc give. Round-3 audit (design/reviews/2026-11-01-sim-audit-round3/casters.md): Shadowfiend (401977) is not cast; a Forever priest cannot learn it (no learn level on its skill-line row, and no beta priest ever cast it). Round-11 audit (design/reviews/2026-11-03-sim-audit-round11/casters.md S1): Dark Sacrifice, the Undead racial, is cast when mana is low and behind the fight's pace.

expected_idle.reason: Inner Focus shares a strictSequence with Mind Blast. It is a Discipline talent the guide build only reaches near level 60, so the truncated leveling builds on the lower rungs do not have it and the sequence never starts there; at level 60 it casts whenever it is ready.

priorityList.notes: Dark Sacrifice (Undead) when mana is below a fifth and running behind the fight: it trades your own health for mana over fifteen seconds and adds your Spirit to it, and its ten minute cooldown makes it a once-a-fight cast. Only Undead priests have it.
Always up; stop refreshing it in the closing seconds of a fight.

Vampiric Embrace on the boss whenever it is down. It costs a global every 30 seconds (its cooldown equals its duration) and heals your whole group for 20% of every Shadow spell you land; your own damage meter never shows that healing. Skip it in the last 10 seconds, and until you have the talent.
Devouring Plague every time its 24 second cooldown is up: every priest has it in Forever, its ticks crit, and it heals you.
Mind Blast on cooldown, with Inner Focus first whenever it is up: Inner Focus makes that Mind Blast free, with 25% more crit chance.
Mind Blast on cooldown, ahead of Mind Flay once you have it: a big hit for its short cast, at half cost in Shadowform.
On cooldown, ahead of Mind Flay: each cast that does not kill costs you 30% of your health, and once you have Vampiric Embrace keep it up to heal that back.
Mind Flay with every free global: let all three ticks land, since a clipped channel loses the rest, and once you have Improved Mind Flay the last tick is the biggest.

Shoot only when nothing else can be cast: a wand shot cannot start during the global cooldown, so it never fits between spells. Once you are shooting, the first shot fires half a second after you press it and the rest come at the wand's speed until you cast again; below level 28 that is most of your damage, so let it run.
